generator.params.note: Hand-set from general knowledge of the species: a spreading clone of unbranched stems 1 to 2 m tall with many narrow, willow-like leaves in a spiral, and a long terminal raceme that opens from the bottom, with seed pods below the open flowers and nodding buds at the tip. Not fitted to measurements.

allometry.note: Rough heights from general knowledge of the species. Replace with measured data before calling this species calibrated.

appearance.note: Colours chosen by eye: four broad magenta petals with a pale centre, deep pink buds, red-purple seed pods and reddish stems.

taxon.note: Common name (and USDA symbol, where given) as the spec's authors wrote them.

growth_form.note: The growth form the spec's authors chose from the plant's habit.

generator.program.note: The program the spec's authors chose to grow this form.

growth.note: The growth plan (years, step, keyframes) chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

variants.note: The environments, conditions and seeds chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

taxon.family.note: WCVP v16's family for the accepted name.

taxon.plant_name_id.note: WCVP v16's plant_name_id for the accepted species the name resolves to (the accepted name).

taxon.scientific_name.note: WCVP v16's accepted name for the plant the spec's authors wrote as Chamaenerion angustifolium, which WCVP treats as a synonym.

taxon.genus.note: The genus WCVP v16's accepted name is written in.

sources.title: Project After contributors: hand-set species values
